Our engineers work across robotics, software, hardware, machine learning, and clinical operations to bring robotic systems from concept to real-world deployment. We’re looking for people who enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and working closely with a small, highly collaborative team.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software systems that power our robotic platform. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, testing, and deploying production software. You will work closely with robotics, controls, hardware, and machine learning engineers to develop systems that are reliable, maintainable, and scalable. This is not a role focused on maintaining legacy systems or implementing isolated features. We are looking for engineers who can take ownership of complex problems, make sound engineering decisions, and drive projects from concept through deployment.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop production software in C++ and Python.

  • Build maintainable, modular, and extensible codebases.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver new product capabilities.

Software Engineering

  • Strong experience developing production software in C++ and/or Python.

  • Experience designing software that can be extended and maintained by a team.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and system design principles.
  • Experience writing tests and validating software behavior. For this role, testing and software quality are a must, not a nice-to-have.

  • Experience with ROS or ROS2.
  • Experience working with real-time or performance-critical systems.

  • Experience with embedded or hardware-adjacent software.
  • Experience working in startup environments.

items.title: UX Designer
items.description: About Andromeda Andromeda is building autonomous surgical robots designed to help surgeons perform procedures more safely, consistently, and efficiently. Our engineers and designers work across robotics, software, hardware, machine learning, and clinical operations to bring robotic systems from concept to real-world deployment. We are a small, highly collaborative team that values ownership, curiosity, craft, and the ability to move quickly from idea to execution. The Role We are looking for a creative UX Designer who thinks like an artist and is comfortable at the intersection of hardware and software. This is not a traditional product design role. You will design the experience through which surgeons control a surgical robot via an iPad, making complex real-time interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and human. Think of it like designing a game where every interaction has real consequences. If the surgeon pushes on tissue, the interface needs to respond visually, the way a game gives you feedback when you hit something. That level of craft and psychological thinking about interaction is what we are looking for. What You’ll Do Design the touchscreen interface that lets surgeons control the robot intuitively in real time. Create visual feedback systems that communicate robot state, tissue interaction, and surgical progress clearly and immediately. Conduct user research with surgeons to understand their mental models, workflows, and pain points. Rapidly prototype and iterate on interaction concepts, from rough sketches to high-fidelity mockups. Work across both 2D and 3D, designing dynamic interfaces with animation and motion, not static screens. Collaborate closely with hardware and software engineers to translate design intent into a working product. Define and maintain design guidelines for the surgical interface. What We’re Looking For 3 to 4 years of experience in UX, interaction design, or a related creative field. A strong portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, high-craft work. This is the main thing we evaluate, more than years of experience. Experience designing something genuinely impressive, ideally involving hardware-software interaction. Real ability across both 2D and 3D design, including dynamic interfaces, animation, and how interactions feel to the user. Experience conducting user research. You should have done user research before and know how to translate insights into design decisions. Comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment where the scope evolves. Nice to Have Background in game design or mobile game development. Background at animation studios. Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, or similar interactive tools. iOS or mobile app design experience. What This Role Is Not This is not a front-end coding role. We have a UI Engineer for that. This is not a traditional enterprise UX role focused on wireframes and user flows. This is not for someone who has only designed digital-only products. What Success Looks Like Successful designers at Andromeda combine strong craft and taste with a deep curiosity about how people interact with complex systems. They prototype quickly, conduct real user research, and design interfaces that feel intuitive even when the underlying system is complex. They collaborate closely with engineers, iterate fast, and care about building something that works in the real world.

items.description: The simple task of buying software, services, or tools at work has become hopelessly complicated at even the most innovative companies in the world. Today, enterprises spend $120T+ per year globally (>30 times larger than annual consumer e-commerce spend) and rely on vendors more than ever before to run their businesses. Our cofounders started Zip in 2020 to address this seemingly intractable problem with a purpose-built procurement platform that provides a simple, consumer-grade user experience. Within the last 4 years, Zip has created a new category and developed the leading solution in this $50B+ TAM space. Today, the world’s leading companies like OpenAI, Snowflake, Anthropic, Coinbase, and Prudential rely on Zip to manage billions of dollars in spend. We have a world-class team coming from category-defining companies like Airbnb, Meta, Stripe, Salesforce, Apple, and Google. With a $2.2 billion valuation and $370 million in funding from Y Combinator, Tiger Global, BOND, DST Global, and CRV, we’re focused on developing cutting-edge technology, expanding into new global markets, and—above all–driving incredible value for our customers. Join us! Your Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for building Zip’s core products and architecture. We have a wide product surface area, covering request management, no-code workflow builders, customer-facing reporting dashboards, connections to ticketing systems, integrations with financial systems, B2B payment processing, and more.
